# Why is your 1099-K higher than what you actually made?

> Free browser worksheet that reconciles one or more Form 1099-K Box 1a totals (Etsy, eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Whatnot, StockX) down to an estimated net profit by backing out refunds, marketplace-remitted sales tax, fees, cost of goods, and shipping. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
